description: Source code for the DifferenceAnalyzer class and object, which performs analysis of differences between messages, manages counters, and generates difference results within a larger system.

classes.name: DifferenceAnalyzer
classes.description: Class responsible for analyzing differences between messages, counting differences, and generating difference results.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis on an AnalysisRequest and returns an optional DifferenceResult.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Calculates differences between messages, updates counters, and creates a DifferenceResult if differences exist.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears counters and stored difference results.

methods.name: differencesToJson
methods.description: Converts a map of differences to a sequence of FieldDifference objects for JSON serialization.

methods.name: getEndpointName
methods.description: Determines the endpoint name based on provided endpoint options, normalizing the name.
